source_asset: Kenney Protagonists (CC0 1.0), one shared skeletal mesh, idle/run/jump

excluded_skins.reason: Exposed cyborg half-face reads as sci-fi and breaks the grounded neon art-deco coastal tone; do not spawn as player or civilian.

material.emissive: none (neon comes from the city, not the characters)

mesh_yaw_note: Suggestion only; Kenney glTF/FBX exports typically face +Y after import, so -90 aligns with UE +X forward. Parent must validate in-engine.
rationale: criminalMaleA's white suit with teal collar is the most on-theme silhouette for a neon art-deco coast and contrasts strongly against the dark night asphalt seen in the screenshot, so the player stays readable from the chase camera.
Keeping the hero skin exclusive makes the player instantly distinguishable from the crowd.
The two skater skins are casual streetwear (jeans, tees, sneakers) and read as believable beachfront civilians; an even split gives a mixed-gender crowd.
Roughness 0.75 with low specular keeps the stylized painted textures matte so magenta/teal neon and street lamps tint them softly instead of producing plastic hotspots.
Textures are painted with soft gradients, not flat palette swatches, so bilinear with mips avoids distance shimmer; nearest would alias on small on-screen NPCs.
178 cm hero matches the existing vehicle and street-furniture scale; slight NPC scale variation breaks up the cloned look of a single shared mesh.
